name: Bit-perfect audio
description: Play Qobuz FLAC byte-exact to your DAC in exclusive mode, bypassing the browser's mixer and resampler. Native sample rate per track, no software volume. Via the bundled player, Linux-only in the wrapper today (the Windows desktop app already has native exclusive-mode audio). Falls back to shared mode with an honest badge if exclusive access isn't available.
author: matthewprince
